thread:
Maya: Quick sync — thinking about how we show cache savings on the cost dashboard when a route has both hotpath and prefetch traffic. current UX lumps credits into a single number which is confusing.
Kevin: agreed. ops teams asked why their hotpath appeared to be 'over-subsidized' in last week's billing preview. :frowning:
Anjali: can we split by cohort (hotpath vs prefetch) and show amortized credits per cohort? that would make the per-invocation econ clearer.
Lia: +1. also need to be careful about sampling: prefetch is batched much more, so naive split will mislead. we should surface sample-rate and an uncertainty badge. :warning:
Maya: proposal: in the route detail panel add a small heatmap with two rows (hotpath, prefetch) and columns for tokens, direct cost, cache-credit, net-cost. hover shows formula and sampling margin.
Sam: what about rollout UX? for canaries we should show a toggle "allocate credits to canary only" vs "amortize across cohort" so PMs can preview invoice impact before flipping.
Kevin: good call. also add an "explain" link that opens a tiny calc:
Kevin: ```
-- net cost per invocation (sampled)
net = direct_cost - (cache_credit * credit_alloc_fraction)
credit_alloc_fraction = if cohort == 'canary' then canary_share else 1.0
```
Anjali: we need a backend metric too. suggested SQL-ish for the telemetry team:
Anjali: ```
select route_id, cohort, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(direct_cost) as direct, sum(cache_saved) as cache_credit, count(1) as invokes
from invocation_econ where ts >= $window and sample_weight is not null
group by route_id, cohort
```
Lia: Important: include sample_weight in aggregation and propagate to UI as "effective_invocations" so small canaries don't look noisy.
CostBot: FYI: There are 42 routes in the last 24h with mixed cohorts where cache_credit > 0 and sample_rate < 1. Use /costbot cohort-check --window=24h to get list. :robot_face:
Maya: Next steps: 1) eng-platform to mock heatmap and canary toggle (Kevin + Lia) 2) telemetry to add cohort/grouping and sample_weight propagation (Anjali) 3) product to write copy for uncertainty badge and explain calc (Maya) 4) quick sync tomorrow 10am PT.
Sam: I'll add a tiny acceptance test to ensure the dashboard shows credit split per cohort and that the toggle changes the preview invoice numbers.
Kevin: I'll drop a rough Figma by EOD. leaning toward compact rows so we can show many routes at once.
Maya: thanks — if anyone spots a route we should use as a pilot (high prefetch, measurable savings) ping here. :eyes:
